verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform with REST APIs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The pack mentions only that a REST API and API keys exist. Nothing shows an interactive reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A CLI reference and llms.txt are adjacent documentation, not an interactive API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
